On Thu, Aug 20, 2026 at 11:08 AM laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Kimberly / Jonas — looping you both in.

Thanks, Laura. Quick initial review of DataLayer_DPA_v3.docx (high-level comments inline):

1) Encryption / key management: DPA states encryption at rest but omits KMS control language. We should insist on explicit customer KMS integration or a contractual guarantee that keys are customer-controlled for customer-scoped workloads.
2) Subprocessor chaining: DPA allows unlimited sub-subprocessors with notice only. Per our MSA, we need either (a) a capped list of categories + right to object within 10 business days, or (b) explicit flow-down obligations mirroring our MSA clauses (incident, access, audit). Ask for the latter.
3) Audit & evidence: SOC2 summary is basic; request either SOC2 Type II report or equivalent security questionnaire (completed) + penetration test summary.
4) Retention & deletion: DPA has a 5-year retention clause that conflicts with EU data minimization expectations; propose a max retention of 90 days for logs by default, with longer retention only by documented customer opt-in.
5) Incident SLA: Specify 72-hour detection + 24-hour notification for confirmed data exposure; 30-day remediation plan for significant incidents.

Action: Laura / Jonas please validate whether the CRM / customer onboarding task needs DataLayer to be blocked until we have signed DPA + SOC2 Type II. If yes, Procurement flag to suspend onboarding.

I can produce a redline later today and flag must-haves vs negotiables.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
[sent attachment: DataLayer_DPA_v3_redline.docx]

Sarah — thanks for the materials and for the quick turnaround. Internal takeaways and next steps below.

1) Legal redline: Kimberly will send a redline and a short requirements list (KPI: KMS/customer key control, retention cap, subproc objection window, SOC2 Type II or equivalent evidence, and incident notification SLAs). Expect that redline by EOD 21 Aug.
2) Procurement check: Jonas to confirm whether eu-west-1 residency is acceptable and whether onboarding halts until DPA/SOC2 are in place.
3) Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
   - 21 Aug: Redwood sends consolidated redline + evidence requests (Kimberly).
   - 24 Aug: Streamline & DataLayer respond with comments and provide SOC2 Type II or equivalent.
   - 28 Aug: Parties agree on final DPA text / DocuSign path.

If Streamline or DataLayer prefer a short triage call, we can do 30-min on Mon 24 Aug at 10:00 PT — otherwise we'll proceed asynchronously.

One note on sequencing: because this affects active customer onboarding, Procurement is asking to pause any flows to production until we receive a signed DPA and SOC2 Type II. If that is a hard stop, please confirm so we can communicate timelines to the customer.
